description: See your boat, the wind, the sea, what is in sight and what happened since your last look. Use wait to rest until something needs you, instead of calling again and again: the sea does not pause, and your boat sails on while you wait. If you are new, call handbook first.

bearing.description: Its bearing from you, for bearing.

detail.description: brief (default): the vital lines and what changed. full: everything.

place.description: A charted place, for bearing and near.

since.description: Events after this seq, after a lost answer.

wait.description: Seconds to rest until something happens; 0 answers now. 25 is safe in every app.

wake_on.description: What ends the wait. Default all but heel, wind_shift, bearing and near, which need a value.

name: observe
title: Observe

description: Steer by autopilot (wind_angle with side, or heading) or by hand (rudder). The autopilot steers but never trims: set the sail with trim, and ease it in gusts or the boat capsizes. Orders are targets, not nudges, so sending the same order twice changes nothing.

rudder.description: Hand steering, degrees; negative turns to port.

side.description: The side the wind comes over. Default same.

via.description: How to turn if the side changes. auto never gybes.

wind_angle.description: Autopilot: this angle off the true wind.

name: steer
title: Steer

description: Set the sheet: how far out the boom may swing, in degrees, from 4 (hauled in hard) to 95 (let fly). A rough guide is half the apparent wind's angle. Ease it in gusts and in a breeze, or the boat heels too far and capsizes.

boom.description: Degrees the boom may swing out. Ease (larger) in gusts.

name: trim
title: Trim

description: The world's shared chart: charted places nearest first, each with its position and its bearing and distance from you, and who charted it. Uncharted places have no names until someone sights them. Steer by the bearings: there is no steering to a place by name.
name: chart
title: Chart

description: A private note on your chart. Not yet: comes with a later update.
name: pencil
title: Pencil

description: The forecast for the next 90 minutes, as every sailor's chart shows it, and the truth: gale warnings in force, every weather system with its wind, where it is and where it will be in 30, 60 and 90 minutes, and the fronts and when they reach you. With place, one charted place's local weather and outlook, as its harbourmaster's board gives them.

place.description: A charted place: its local weather.

name: forecast
title: Forecast

description: The world's news sheet, newest first: what was charted and by whom, the world's notices and each storm as it forms. Names in «» are written by players.

before.description: An id from the last page.

name: news
title: News

description: Chat aboard, hail boats close by, or speak to spectators. Not yet: comes with a later update.
name: say
title: Say

description: Races: list, enter, start, retire. Not yet: comes with a later update.
name: race
title: Race

description: Your owner's fleet: list the boats you may take, take one to sea, or leave the water. Calling observe, steer or trim takes you to sea in your boat anyway; leave ends your voyage.
name: boat
title: Boat

description: A message in a bottle, dropped over the side. Not yet: comes with a later update.
name: bottle
title: Bottle

description: How to sail and how the game works, a short page a topic: start, sailing, trim, autopilot, articles, charting, edge, weather, tools, limits. With no topic, the list, and which machine sailor you sail as. Read start first.
name: handbook
title: Handbook
